title: All Aboard Sailing

services.name: Sailing With Us
services.desc: Sailing with a maximum of six passengers we adjust to the level at which you’re ready to adventure and heel with the boat. Your confidence will grow as you become accustomed to the dynamics of sailing in the pacific northwest. In a short time you’ll feel connected to the Salish Sea and the abundant wildlife. As we sail we are always looking and listening for eagles, seals and sea lions, a variety of birds, porpoises and whales. We like to hug the coastline admiring the forest and geology. And so relax on the foredeck in our comfy bean bag chairs and enjoy the ride. Every trip is different. services.name: Whale Listening
services.desc: Transient Orcas (also now known as Biggs orcas) tend to be silent to gain an element of surprise in hunting marine mammals. However on occasion we encounter them being playful in a social group or when they have just finished hunting and need no longer be silent. This recording was 06:40 July 27th, 2018. Just the J17s were on the West side of San Juan Island through all of today. This is the fourth day of J35 carrying along her dead calf. May 11th, 2026, Mummy Rocks, South Lopez. This recording of Biggs Orcas includes the T86A1’s, T86A3, T90’s, T100E, and T124A4’s with T46B1’s, T46C2, T123’s and T65A3.
